lastCompletedStory.title: Adopt biome as a lint-only gate (lean ruleset + grandfather overrides)

nextStoryContext: biome.json is live with lint-only mode (linter.enabled:true, formatter.enabled:false, recommended:false, two complexity rules). Grandfather overrides cover 21 files. The lint gate is at index 3 in GATES (between embed-vendor and ci-parity). bun run lint exits 0. Next stories can add more ratchet/dup gates to the spine.

officialDocsValidated.summary: biome 2.x overrides structure (includes + linter.rules per-file) confirmed. recommended field is deprecated (use preset:none) but still accepted as info-only, not error. formatter.enabled:false and noExcessiveLinesPerFunction options.maxLines all match implementation.
